title: Crypto test vectors / property tests
preconditions: vector set or property to test
steps: Load Wycheproof JSON for the primitive; run every vector and compare accept/reject, not just success cases.
Add property tests: round-trip, boundary values (0, n-1, max), malformed lengths, and nonce/IV reuse.
For a live oracle, batch queries within rate limits and record the exact input/response.
Treat a single passing vector as insufficient; require the full edge-case set or a reproducible property violation.
falsifier: All vectors and properties pass; the primitive is correctly implemented and the bug is elsewhere.
